text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear stance in opening and closing","quality":"positioning","description":"The essay states a definite position early and returns to it at the end so the reader always knows where it stands."},{"evidence":"talks about text facts like cars not truly driverless and needing human involvement","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses details from the article to back up its claims rather than relying mainly on personal opinion."},{"evidence":"explains distracted driving and then connects it to driverless-car safety","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay develops cause-and-effect thinking that links its evidence to the argument it is making."},{"evidence":"repeats safety concerns with examples like greasy hands and pulling out of a parking lot","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay expands ideas with specific scenarios that make the argument more concrete and convincing."},{"evidence":"mentions both benefits and worries before settling on a view","quality":"balanced consideration","description":"The essay acknowledges multiple sides of the issue before arguing its final position."}]}
